cloudflare.durable_objects.duration.note: The first 400,000 GB-s a month are free units, included in Workers Paid for the whole account ("400,000 GB-s / month", https://developers.cloudflare.com/durable-objects/platform/pricing/). Billable usage is rounded up to the next million GB-s, which is not modelled. Read on the pricing page; Cloudflare publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it

cloudflare.durable_objects.requests.note: HTTP requests, RPC sessions and alarm invocations each count one; incoming WebSocket messages count one per 20. The first 1 million a month are free units, included in Workers Paid for the whole account ("1 million / month, + $0.15/million", https://developers.cloudflare.com/durable-objects/platform/pricing/). Read on the pricing page; Cloudflare publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it

cloudflare.durable_objects.rows_read.note: SQLite backend; the same rate as D1 but its own allowance. The first 25 billion a month are free units for the whole account ("First 25 billion / month included", https://developers.cloudflare.com/durable-objects/platform/pricing/). Read on the pricing page; Cloudflare publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it

cloudflare.durable_objects.rows_written.note: SQLite backend; deletes and setAlarm count as rows written. The first 50 million a month are free units for the whole account ("First 50 million / month included", https://developers.cloudflare.com/durable-objects/platform/pricing/). Read on the pricing page; Cloudflare publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it

cloudflare.durable_objects.storage.note: SQLite backend.
